company.name: Allium
company.shortDescription: Allium provides blockchain data infrastructure for institutions and crypto-focused organizations.
company.description: Allium provides blockchain data infrastructure for institutions and crypto-focused organizations. It collects, verifies, and standardizes data from more than 150 blockchains and thousands of protocols, making on-chain activity easier to analyze and use in operational workflows. The company delivers historical and real-time data through APIs, data streams, data shares, dashboards, and query tools. Its datasets support applications such as transaction reconciliation, analytics, compliance, payments, and digital asset research. Allium also offers tools for querying, visualizing, and accessing blockchain data to help organizations build applications and monitor activity across multiple blockchain networks.
